title: Uwell Caliburn G3 Pod Vape Kit
description: Get ready to experience next-level vaping with the Uwell Caliburn G3, the latest evolution in the renowned Caliburn G series of pod kits. Designed for vapers of all levels, the Caliburn G3 is a sleek and effortless vape companion that is lightweight and stylish too. With its beefy 900mAh integrated battery, this kit ensures you can enjoy extended vaping sessions without interruption. Whether you prefer a looser, Restricted Direct to Lung (RDL) draw or a more intense Mouth to Lung (MTL) vaping style, the Caliburn G3's versatile 5-25W output has you covered. Turning the pod around in the device offers two further airflow options. The Caliburn G3 features a single button for simple operation and power adjustment between 5-25W, giving you the freedom to personalize your vapour production. Alternatively, you can choose the buttonless auto-draw option , and simply inhale to activate the device. All your settings are displayed on a compact yet clear OLED screen . Inside the box, you'll find two Caliburn G3 pods with fixed coils that allow for two styles of vaping. The inclusion of 0.6 Ohm and 0.9 Ohm pods allows you to switch effortlessly between RDL and MTL vaping styles. When it's time to replace the coil, just swap out the old pod with the new one for a super-convenient and mess-free experience. The Caliburn G3 Pods boast mesh coils equipped with Pro-FOCS Flavour Technology, delivering a flavour boost and longer-lasting coil life. Best used with 50/50 and Nic Salt E-liquids Charging is a breeze too, with 2A Type-C fast charging , ensuring your 900mAh battery powers up swiftly, minimizing any downtime. Plus, for added portability, there’s a lanyard included in the kit so you can keep your Caliburn G3 by your side wherever you go. Elevate your vaping game with the Uwell Caliburn G3 - the ultimate blend of style, versatility, and satisfaction. Explore our wide variety of e-liquids and pick the perfect partner for your vape kit. Please note: When filling your pod with e-liquid for the first time, allow the pod to sit for ten minutes before use. This will allow the e-liquid to better saturate the wicking material, a type of cotton, to prevent dry hits and ensure the best flavour and performance from your coil.
